notes: Named boundaries + generated integers/refusals; 10k/1m digit runs.

notes: Every short/control escape, scalar/surrogate boundaries, raw controls, NUL/DEL/noncharacters/non-BMP.

notes: Overlong 2/3/4, surrogate encodings, >10FFFF, continuation/truncation/continuation mismatch; keys too.

notes: Named grammar errors + generated valid structures, arbitrary bytes + mutations.

notes: Every named consequence + generated depth/grammar/size mixtures; text judged before size/duplicates.

notes: Both named examples, escaped aliases, parent/text-order precedence, least byte key, mixed key/index paths.

notes: Expected recursive byte-key ordering from independent tree; includes non-BMP vs BMP + normalization distinctions.

clause: J5 Value.object: stable key-byte sort of the outer members, repeats kept, children untouched
notes: Total constructor law: stable equal-key order, repeated outer members + unchanged unsorted/repeated child (MAIN Ruling 1).

clause: J5 get?: first equal key's value; absent key or non-object → none; JSON null → some null
notes: Total accessor law: first repeated key, null vs absent, every nonobject, exact scalar-sequence equality (MAIN Ruling 1).

clause: J5 asBool?/asInt?/asStr?/asArr?/asObj?: payload of their constructor, none otherwise
notes: Constructor payload/none matrix across named + generated values; null gives no accessor payload.

notes: Every print input Valid; explicit depth/size/control/Unicode boundaries + generated values.

notes: Valid reference outcomes; alternate/canonical texts equal; distinct scalar/array canonical bytes unequal; operands oracle-anchored.
